title: Generate Global Options
text: two basic fields used check input option values: code, .value default value option . length value controlled .length length either 1 3. class value numeric. input value fit criterions, error. value .length .class vector checking passed one value fits user’s input.
code: opt = set_opt(     a = list(.value = 1,              .length = c(1, 3),              .class = "numeric") ) opt(a = 1:2)  # there will be error because the length is 2 Error: Length of 'a' should be one of 1, 3. opt(a = "text")  # there will be error because the input is character Error: Class of 'a' should be 'numeric'.

code: opt = set_opt(     a = list(.value = 1,              .read.only = TRUE) ) opt(a = 2)  # there will be error because a is read-only Error: 'a' is a read-only option. opt = set_opt(     a = list(.value = 1,              .read.only = TRUE),     b = 2 ) opt(READ.ONLY = TRUE) $a [1] 1 opt(READ.ONLY = FALSE) $b [1] 2 opt(READ.ONLY = NULL)  # default, to return both $a [1] 1  $b [1] 2

title: Generate Global Options
text: customized validation option values can controlled .validate field. value .validate function. input validation function input option value function return logical value. 0 10 following example. .failed_msg used configure error message validation failed.
code: opt = set_opt(     a = list(.value = 1,              .validate = function(x) x > 0 && x < 10     ) ) opt(a = 20)  # This will cause an error Error: a didn't pass the validation. Your option is invalid. opt = set_opt(     a = list(.value = 1,              .validate = function(x) x > 0 && x < 10,              .failed_msg = "'a' should be in (0, 10)."     ) ) opt(a = 20)  # This will cause an error Error: a didn't pass the validation. 'a' should be in (0, 10).

title: Generate Global Options
text: Filtering option values can controlled .filter field. useful input option value valid necessary throw errors. proper way modify value silently. example, option control whether print messages set TRUE FALSE. However, users may set type values NULL NA. case, non-TRUE values can converted logical values .filter. Similar .validate, input value filter function input option value, return filtered option value. Another example option controls four margin values plot, length value can either 1, 2, 4. .filter, length can normaliezd 4 consistently.
code: opt = set_opt(     verbose =          list(.value = TRUE,              .filter = function(x) {                  if(is.null(x)) {                      return(FALSE)                  } else if(is.na(x)) {                      return(FALSE)                  } else {                      return(x)                  }               }) ) opt(verbose = FALSE); opt("verbose") [1] FALSE opt(verbose = NA); opt("verbose") [1] FALSE opt(verbose = NULL); opt("verbose") [1] FALSE opt = set_opt(     margin =          list(.value = c(1, 1, 1, 1),              .length = c(1, 2, 4),              .filter = function(x) {                 if(length(x) == 1) {                     return(rep(x, 4))                 } else if(length(x) == 2) {                     return(rep(x, 2))                 } else {                     return(x)                 }             }) ) opt(margin = 2); opt("margin") [1] 2 2 2 2 opt(margin = c(2, 4)); opt("margin") [1] 2 4 2 4

text: Two additional fields may helpful developing packages. .visible controls whether options visible users. invisible option can queried modified specifying option name (just like can open door correct unique key). helpful users want put secret options want others access. case, can assign names complex strings like .__MY_PRIVATE_KEY__. secret options afterwards can access special key. Another field .private controls whether option private namespace (e.g. packages). set TRUE, option can modified namespace (top environment) option function generated. E.g, writing package named foo generating option function foo_opt(), setting option .private TRUE, value options can modified inside foo package permitted outside foo. time, private options become read-options querying outside foo package. following example, manually modify namespace set_opt() called stats package. error trying modify private stats namespace. can still access . option object generated set_opt() actually function. contains four arguments: ..., RESET, READ., LOCAL, ADD. want put option function package, remember document four arguments:

text: simplest way construct option function (e.g. opt()) :   users can get set options   Options can reset default values :   value option can set list contains complex configurations:   different fields list can used filter validate option values. .value: default value. .length: valid length option value. can vector, check passed one length fits. .class: valid class option value. can vector, check passed one classes fits. .validate: Validation function. input parameter option value return single logical value. .failed_msg: validation failed, error message printed. .filter: Filtering function. input parameter option value return filtered option value. .read.: Logical. option value can modified set TRUE. .visible: Logical. Whether option visible users. .private: Logical. option value can modified namespace option function created. .synonymous: single option name already defined ahead current option. option specified shared current option. .description: short text describing option. description used printing object. detailed explanation, please go vignette.
